name: Nanase
source:
A girl with a slightly mysterious atmosphere whom Akira met at the river. She seems to be a village girl, but she doesn't tell us anything about her.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bokunatsu.html]official site[/url]]
